title: EliteSharp ship type
description: The attributes of one of the 33 ship types. The ship's wireframe is in the glTF model named by 'model'.

type.description: The ship type number (1-33), as used by the game logic. Each type must be defined exactly once.

model.description: The path of the ship's glTF 2.0 model, relative to this file.

laserPower.description: The power of the ship's lasers (0 for none).

missiles.description: The number of missiles the ship carries.

bounty.description: The bounty for destroying the ship, in credits (to one decimal place).

targetRadius.description: The radius within which the ship can be hit by lasers or targeted by missiles.

canisters.description: The most cargo canisters released when the ship is destroyed.

scoopedAs.description: The market item the ship turns into when scooped (leave out if it can't be scooped).

killPoints.description: The points added to the kill tally for destroying the ship (in 256ths; 256 points to go from Harmless to Competent).

colour.description: The ship's colour in the space view (green is cyan and yellow stripes, white is cyan and red stripes, and moray is the Moray's pattern of cyan, red, a gap and yellow).

scannerColour.description: The colour of the ship on the scanner (none for a ship that doesn't show up).
